tools.name: carelinelive_list_carers
tools.description: List carers (care workers) in the CareLineLive environment, with their contract, team and employment fields. Filters are partial matches; not_on_leave excludes carers on leave in a period. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/carers.

tools.name: carelinelive_get_carer
tools.description: Show one carer by id, with optional related resources. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/carers/{carer}.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (people receiving care) with their details and status. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/clients.

tools.name: carelinelive_get_client
tools.description: Show one client by id, with optional related resources. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/clients/{client}.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_users
tools.description: List office users (accounts that sign in to CareLineLive). CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/users.

tools.name: carelinelive_get_user
tools.description: Show one office user by id. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/users/{user}.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams (branches or groups of carers and clients) in the environment. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/teams.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_visit_rounds
tools.description: List visit rounds (planned visit runs for carers). CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/visit-rounds.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_leaves
tools.description: List carer leave records (holiday and other absences). CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/leaves.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_incidents
tools.description: List recorded incidents (care events that need follow-up). CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/incidents.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_public_holidays
tools.description: List the public holidays set up for the environment. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/public-holidays.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_work_patterns
tools.description: List the work patterns (standard weekly hours) used to plan carer contracts. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/work-patterns.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_permissions
tools.description: List the permissions in the environment, so you can see what the access token can read. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/permissions.

tools.name: carelinelive_update_carer
tools.description: Change a carer's payroll number, payroll department code or cost centre code. Only the fields you send change; sending the same values again has no further effect. Other carer fields are not changed by this tool. CareLineLive API: PATCH /api/v2/carers/{carer}.
